name: mock-api-server
description: Mock API server for proxy voting and shareholder meeting management

scripts.generate:seeds: npx tsx ../supabase/seed.ts && npx tsx ../supabase/seed.ts > ../supabase/seed.sql && pnpm run sync:seed-data
scripts.sync:seed-data: mkdir -p data/migrations && cp ../supabase/seed.sql data/seed.sql && cp -r ../supabase/migrations/*.sql data/migrations/
scripts.generate:db-types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > utils/supabase/database.types.ts
scripts.generate:postgres-schema: openapi-generator-cli generate -i ./openapi-schema/openapi.yaml -g postgresql-schema -o ../supabase/migrations --additional-properties=identifierNamingConvention=snake_case,defaultDatabaseName=public,schemaName=public && npx tsx cli/extract-core-schema.ts
scripts.seed:reset: pnpm run generate:seeds && supabase db reset && pnpm run seed:documents:clean
scripts.full-reset: pnpm run generate:postgres-schema && pnpm run generate:seeds && supabase db reset && pnpm run generate:db-types && pnpm run generate:api-types && tsx scripts/ensure-documents-bucket.ts npx tsx scripts/seed-documents.ts -- --clean && npx tsx scripts/seed-documents.ts -- --link
scripts.seed:remote: npx tsx scripts/truncate-remote.ts && sleep 2 && npx tsx scripts/migrate-remote.ts && sleep 2 && npx tsx scripts/seed-remote.ts
